condiciones: We do not work from stock. Each project is selected block-direct from the quarry; photos and video of the actual block are submitted for written approval before the order is released.
We do not supply physical samples. Every block is unique, and we prefer the client to approve exactly the material that will be used in the project.
Slab size depends on the block; the usual working format is approximately 120 x 76 inches.
Natural stone carries inherent variation in vein, tone and background. Variation is a property of the material, not a defect.
Lead time: 6–8 weeks from written block approval to delivery, subject to quarry availability.
Prices assume substrate and cabinet carcass are supplied and installed by others, plumb and square, ready to receive stone.
Field measurements must be confirmed on site before fabrication is released. Changes after release are quoted separately.
MILLIMETER surfaces contain less than 0.5% silica, versus 40–80% in engineered quartz — safer handling for fabricators and installers.
This quotation is valid for the period stated above. Quarry pricing is subject to change after that date.
